label: At w, one of: some concrete individual exists at w and at every accessible world; or the selected…
paraphrase: At w, one of: some concrete individual exists at w and at every accessible world; or the selected relation restricted to actual concreta is well-founded and some actual concretum is a root of it that does not exist at every accessible world; or that restricted relation is not well-founded. The first horn can hold together with either other horn; the second and third exclude each other. The third horn does not say whether a cycle or an unending descent fails well-foundedness. Neither is claimed actual or metaphysically possible; a root is a root of the selected relation only.
